Improved Wrath.text: Reduces the cast time of your Wrath spell by 0.1 sec and its Mana cost by 10%.

Genesis.text: Increases the periodic damage and healing done by your spells and abilities by 1%.

Moonglow.text: Reduces the Mana cost of your damaging spells by 8%.

Improved Moonfire.text: Increases the damage and critical strike chance of your Moonfire spell by 5%.

Nature's Majesty.text: Increases your critical strike chance with spells and melee attacks by 2%.

Nature's Reach.text: Increases the range of your offensive Balance spells by 10% and improves your chance to hit by 2%.

Nature's Splendor.text: Increases the duration of your Moonfire and Rejuvenation spells by 3 sec, your Regrowth spell by 6 sec, and your Insect Swarm spell by 2 sec.

Insect Swarm.text: The enemy target is swarmed by insects, decreasing their chance to hit with attacks by 2% and causing 48 Nature damage over 12 sec.

Vengeance.text: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Arcane and Nature spells by 20%.

Improved Starfire.text: Reduces the cast time of Starfire by 0.1 sec and Starfire has a 3% chance to stun its target for 3 sec.

Overgrowth.text: Increases the maximum number of targets you may have affected by Entangling Roots by 1.

Nature's Grace.text: All non-periodic spell criticals grace you with a blessing of nature, increasing your spellcasting speed and reducing your global cooldown by 10% for 3 sec.

Eclipse.text: Your Wrath spell reduces the cast time of your next 2 Starfire spells by 0.17 sec. Stores up to 4 charges. Lasts 15 sec.

Feral Swiftness.text: Increases your movement speed while in Cat Form by 15%, and increases your chance to Dodge by 2%.

Savage Fury.text: Increases the damage caused by your Claw, Rake, Shred, Maul, and Swipe abilities by 5%.

Primal Bite.text: Bite the target, dealing 100% normal damage plus 26 and generating a high amount of threat.

Predatory Strikes.text: Increases your melee Attack Power in Cat Form, Bear Form, and Dire Bear Form by 50% of your level.

Improved Shifting Power.text: Reduces the cooldown of your Shifting Power spell by 4 sec.

Leader of the Pack.text: While in Cat Form, Bear Form, or Dire Bear Form, the Leader of the Pack increases the melee and ranged Critical Strike chance of all party or raid members within 45 yards by 3%.

Natural Instinct.text: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your melee abilities by 10% and increases your spell healing by 12% of your Intellect.

Natural Reaction.text: Increases your dodge chance by 1%, and gives you a 20% chance to gain 5 Rage each time you dodge.

Rend and Tear.text: Increases damage done by your melee abilities on Bleeding targets by 2%.

Natural Shapeshifter.text: Reduces the mana cost of all shapeshifting by 10%.

Reflection.text: Allows 17% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting.

Gift of Nature.text: Increases the effect of all your healing spells by 2%.

Gift of the Earthmother.text: Reduces the global cooldown by 0.5 seconds on your Rejuvenation, Swiftmend, and Wild Growth spells.
